label: Understanding the Nature and Impact of Chest Pain in Postural Orthostatic Tachycardia Syndrome.
summary: Postural orthostatic tachycardia syndrome (POTS) is a chronic autonomic disorder that predominantly affects female patients of childbearing age. Chest pain is a common and debilitating symptom in POTS, but the nature of the chest pain and the patient experience surrounding it remain poorly understood.
